title: FEDformer: Error accumulation dominates FEDformer performance at horizon 720 on ETTh1, ETTh2, Weather
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using FEDformer, a frequency-enhanced decomposition transformer. On ETTh1, ETTh2, Weather, at horizon 720, Error accumulation dominates FEDformer performance at horizon 720 on ETTh1, ETTh2, Weather. MSE at horizon 720 is 26% higher than at horizon 336 for the same FEDformer configuration. We discuss two limitations: Comparison omits linear baselines that recent work has shown to be competitive. The training corpus is limited to a single domain, so cross-domain robustness is not established. Future work should address analysing attention weights to test the interpretability hypothesis. and reporting per-seed variance and confidence intervals for the headline metric.
